_about.what: REAL response from the BLS Public Data API v1 (no key): monthly PPI series, January 2024 to September 2026. Includes one id BLS says does not exist (WPU10260306) and one with gaps (WPU11740999).
_about.trimming: The request asked for 25 series; Results.series keeps these 12 complete: WPU10260314, WPU10260306, WPU11710216, WPU1171, WPU117522, WPU108303, WPU1174, WPU11740999, WPUIP2312001, PCU23821X23821X, PCU3353133353133, WPU117. status, responseTime and message are as returned.
